# OpenPay Pro Wallet

> OpenPay + OpenPay Pro partner APIs for Connect (OAuth), payments (PayButton charges), payouts (transfers), top-up / inbound, Public Ledger, and MCP. Currency: OUSD. No charge webhooks — poll. Keep `opk_live_` keys on the server only.

## AI-first partner pack (start here)

- [AI Partner Integration Pack](https://openpaypi.space/docs/ai): Single guide for OpenAI, ChatGPT, Cursor, Lovable, Replit, Claude — auth, pay, top-up, inbound, ledger.
- [Pro Pay · Merchant](https://openpaypi.space/docs/pro-pay): Partner checkout — charges, receive @username/wallet, inbound earnings, Top Up methods, env & copy-paste.
- [Pro Connect · Auth & Pay](https://openpaypi.space/docs/integrations): Native Pro OAuth + OUSD charges (`opro_live_` / `oprat_`).
- [Pro Partner API](https://openpaypi.space/partner-api): Create apps — client ID, secret, OAuth callbacks.
- [Raw AI guide (markdown)](https://openpaypi.space/api/public/docs/ai-partner): Paste into any LLM / agent.
- [Full dump](https://openpaypi.space/llms-full.txt): Consolidated partner + Pro docs for long-context agents.
- [OpenAPI](https://openpaypi.space/api/public/docs/openapi): Machine-readable Partner Transfer + Pro inbound/ledger.

## Bases

- Partner Transfer API: `https://araojncyittkahvvpdrn.supabase.co/functions/v1/partner-transfer-api`
- Partner portal (keys): https://openpy.space/partner-api
- Connect: https://openpy.space/connect
- Pro inbound: `POST https://openpaypi.space/api/public/openpay/inbound`
- Ledger: https://openpaypi.space/api/public/ledger
- MCP: https://openpaypi.space/mcp

## Developer portal

- [Developer Portal](https://openpaypi.space/docs): Hub for every integration path.
- [Quickstart](https://openpaypi.space/docs#quickstart): Ship Connect + payments in one afternoon.
- [Connect & payments](https://openpaypi.space/docs/openpay): OAuth, PayButton, inbound, auth methods.
- [Pro Connect · Auth & Pay](https://openpaypi.space/docs/integrations): Native Pro OAuth + OUSD charges.
- [Exchange · OUSD](https://openpaypi.space/docs/exchange): Deposit, withdraw, swap, reconcile.
- [Money rails](https://openpaypi.space/docs/money): Send, receive, deposit, withdraw, swap.
- [Tokens & assets](https://openpaypi.space/docs/tokens): OUSD, majors, OpenToken, NFT.
- [Partner Transfer API](https://openpaypi.space/docs/api): Transfers, charges, OAuth token.
- [Public Ledger API](https://openpaypi.space/docs/ledger): Append-only transaction mirror.
- [Agent Connect · MCP](https://openpaypi.space/docs/mcp): Tools for ChatGPT, Claude, agents.
- [Authentication](https://openpaypi.space/docs/auth): Pro methods + Connect OAuth.
- [Errors & retries](https://openpaypi.space/docs/errors): HTTP codes, polling, idempotency.
- [FAQ](https://openpaypi.space/docs/faq): Wallets, fees, partner teaser.
- [Raw markdown feeds](https://openpaypi.space/docs#raw): `/api/public/docs/*`
